verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an AI Editor that lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts. That is a real first-party natural-language interface, but it covers only one narrow area of the product. Its other AI features (evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence) are automated analysis rather than command-driven operation, and the GitHub compliance-skills are coding-agent add-ons for scanning codebases, not a way to operate Sprinto. Missing for 10: natural-language operation across the core product (controls, risks, policies, audits, tasks); a general conversational assistant or command interface; depth documentation of the AI Editor; independent or hands-on corroboration.
